title: Email/get: reject unknown property names with invalidArguments
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E15. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: S.

Follow-up bug found while designing EmailPush. Spec: RFC 8620 §5.1 "If an invalid property is requested, the call MUST be rejected with an invalidArguments error." Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §11, §5.2.

Today mail-server Email/get's filter_properties silently drops unknown property names. After the project.rs refactor, make Email/get reject any name that project::check_email_property does not accept, with method-level invalidArguments. Keep header:* forms and metadata names (when the metadata URI is in using) valid. objectHistory: the plain handler rejects it, while object-history's history-aware Email/get strips it before this check (docs/design/object-history.md §5), which matches EmailPush's email_history gating (decision 10).
Acceptance: Email/get with properties ["nope"] => invalidArguments; existing valid-property tests pass; CHANGELOG notes the wire behaviour change.
